text: The global transformer processes patch representations while small local modules encode and decode the bytes inside and around each patch.
Naïve byte tokenization naturally handles 東京, Αθήνα, and emoji 🚀 because UTF-8 supplies a deterministic sequence of integer units.
A distributed checkpoint contains model and optimizer state in distcp files plus per-rank iterator state for exact continuation.
Loss values are not scientific results in this fixture; finite loss and gradients are the meaningful assertions for this stage.
